paper.title_en: Brans-Dicke Theory with $Λ{\ensuremath >} 0$: Black Holes and Large Scale Structures
paper.abstract_en: A step-by-step approach is followed to study cosmic structures in the context of Brans-Dicke theory with positive cosmological constant $Λ$ and parameter $ω$. First, it is shown that regular stationary black-hole solutions not only have constant Brans-Dicke field $φ$, but can exist only for $ω=\infty$, which forces the theory to coincide with the General Relativity. Generalizations of the theory in order to evade this black-hole no-hair theorem are presented. It is also shown that in the absence of a stationary cosmological event horizon in the asymptotic region, a stationary black hole horizon can support a non-trivial Brans-Dicke hair. Even more importantly, it is shown next, that the presence of a stationary cosmological event horizon rules out any regular stationary solution, appropriate for the description of a star. Thus, to describe a star one has to assume that there is no such stationary horizon in the faraway asymptotic region. Under this implicit assumption generic spherical cosmic structures are studied perturbatively and is shown that only for $ω>0$ or $ω\lesssim -5$ their predicted maximum sizes are consistent with observations. We also point out how, many of the conclusions of this work differ qualitatively from the $Λ=0$ spacetimes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文系统研究了带正宇宙学常数Λ的Brans-Dicke理论中的黑洞无毛定理、非平凡标量毛以及球状宇宙结构的微扰增长，并对参数ω给出可观测约束，属于修改引力理论中Brans-Dicke/scalar-tensor家族的实质理论工作，题目提供的方法与结论具有清晰的后续阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: 带 $\Lambda > 0$ 的 Brans-Dicke 理论：黑洞与大尺度结构
decision.abstract_zh: 本文采用逐步推进的方法，在带正宇宙学常数 $\Lambda$ 和参数 $\omega$ 的 Brans-Dicke 理论背景下研究宇宙结构。首先，文中表明，规则的稳态黑洞解不仅具有常数的 Brans-Dicke 场 $\varphi$，而且只能存在于 $\omega=\infty$ 的情形，这就迫使该理论与广义相对论一致。文中还给出了为规避这一黑洞无毛定理而对该理论所做的推广。文中同样表明，在渐近区域不存在稳态宇宙学事件视界的情况下，稳态黑洞视界可以支撑非平凡的 Brans-Dicke 毛。更为重要的是，文中接下来表明，稳态宇宙学事件视界的存在排除了任何适合描述恒星的规则稳态解。因此，要描述恒星，就必须假设在遥远的渐近区域不存在这样的稳态视界。在这一隐含假设下，文中对一般的球状宇宙结构进行了微扰研究，并表明只有当 $\omega>0$ 或 $\omega\lesssim -5$ 时，所预言的这些结构的最大尺度才与观测相符。文中还指出，本工作的许多结论与 $\Lambda=0$ 时空的情形存在定性上的差异。
